name: Born in the Saddle

source.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Cheliax, Infernal Inheritance

text:
Access You're from Nidal.

---
You've been riding so long that the saddle feels like solid ground. You take only a –1 circumstance penalty to Reflex saves while mounted. If your mount is knocked Unconscious and falls Prone, you can Mount to dismount your mount as a free action, standing in an unoccupied square of your choosing adjacent to your mount.
